name: trekr
description: A Ruby language server backed by trekr: receiver-aware definitions, references narrowed by receiver, completion, call hierarchy.

trekr.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `trekr` binary. The default finds it on `PATH`; set an absolute path if VS Code's `PATH` doesn't include it (e.g. `/opt/homebrew/bin/trekr`).

trekr.features.markdownDescription: Which trekr features are active. Remove one to leave it to another extension — e.g. drop `diagnostics` if another server already reports Ruby syntax errors. Takes effect on restart.

trekr.index.markdownDescription: Index an unindexed checkout in the background (runs `trekr --index`, with progress in the status bar). Off: answers come from whatever `trekr --index` last recorded.

trekr.referenceLimit.markdownDescription: Most locations Find All References returns, confirmed callers first. When more exist, trekr says so and names the `trekr --refs` command that lists them all. Restart trekr to apply.

enumDescriptions: Its guesses, only when the first is a fair one (trekr's confidence at least 0.5).
Every guess, best first, as a peek list.
trekr.unresolved.markdownDescription: What Go to Definition shows for a call trekr could not resolve, whose ranked guesses it still has. An editor shows a guess as it shows an answer, so `confident` holds back the weak ones; hover still says the call was unresolved. Restart trekr to apply.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/e2e/run.js
